display_name: Hong Kong Compliance 2026 — Stablecoins Ordinance, AMLO + VATP, SFO, PDPO
description: Structured knowledge graph for Hong Kong's 2025-2026 regulatory wave: the Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 643) live 1 August 2025 — the world's only dedicated stablecoin statute outside MiCA; HKMA expected to issue first licences Q1 2026. Plus the AMLO (Cap. 615) framework with June 2023 amendments bringing VATPs under SFC Type 1 + Type 7 licensing; SFO (Cap. 571) capital-markets foundation; Banking Ordinance + Insurance Ordinance; PDPO (Cap. 486) data protection + 2021 doxxing amendments + pending mandatory breach notification reform; Prevention of Bribery Ordinance (Cap. 201); UN Sanctions Ordinance (Cap. 537); HKEX Listing Rules + ESG Reporting Guide (ISSB-aligned climate phased); HKMA Supervisory Policy Manual; SFC Code of Conduct + guidelines.
